requirements.title: IEEE_VALUE signaling-NaN exception and quieting latitude
requirements.definition: For a signaling NaN returned by IEEE_VALUE, whether invalid is raised and whether the signaling NaN is converted into a quiet NaN are processor dependent.

pending.IEEE_VALUE-signaling-NaN-invalid-latitud: No portable flag-state oracle exists. INVALID-FLAG-SAFE-PREAMBLE for expected signaling flag IEEE_INVALID: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,0.0). Supported-flag branch clears IEEE_INVALID with IEEE_SET_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,.FALSE.), clears IEEE_OVERFLOW, IEEE_DIVIDE_BY_ZERO, IEEE_UNDERFLOW, and IEEE_INEXACT where their concrete IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(flag,0.0) probes are true, HALTING-OFF sub-branch for IEEE_INVALID: probe IEEE_SUPPORT_HALTING(IEEE_INVALID); true branch calls IEEE_SET_HALTING_MODE(IEEE_INVALID,.FALSE.); false branch calls IEEE_GET_HALTING_MODE(IEEE_INVALID,halting) after the same concrete IEEE_SUPPORT_FLAG(IEEE_INVALID,0.0) true branch and continues only in the halting .FALSE. branch; unsupported-flag or halting .TRUE. branches record skips. Supported-safe branch additionally probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0), clears IEEE_INVALID immediately before IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), then reads IEEE_INVALID; quiet and signaling outcomes are both permitted by this unit.
pending.IEEE_VALUE-signaling-NaN-quieting-latitu: No portable class-conversion oracle has a single expected result. Probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) and IEEE_SUPPORT_NAN(0.0); supported-NaN branch calls IEEE_VALUE(0.0,IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN), then probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(result) and observes IEEE_IS_NAN(result)==.true. and either IEEE_CLASS(result)==IEEE_SIGNALING_NAN or IEEE_CLASS(result)==IEEE_QUIET_NAN, because both class outcomes are permitted by this unit.
